preconditions.description: The number of breakfasts b must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^18.
The number of dinners d must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^18.
The number of suppers s must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^18.
The total number of meals b + d + s must be at least 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(0, (b + d + s) - (max(b, d, s) + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of missed meals, calculated as the total meals minus the maximum of the three meal counts plus one.
